GetComponents returns the position and nine rotation entries in the same order accepted by the 12-argument CFrame.new constructor.
records.action: When preserving an existing transform, retain the CFrame or reconstruct its full 12 components without an unnecessary Euler conversion. For signed rotation direction or accumulated turns, retain that scalar/state separately. Compare transform components or basis vectors within a stated tolerance; do not diagnose a changed orientation solely from a -180/+180 Euler label.
records.exceptions: CFrame.Angles and fromOrientation use different rotation orders, so mixed-axis inputs are not interchangeable. Floating-point residuals and Euler branch choices can affect values near a half-turn. Exact components should not be rounded before reconstruction.
records.unknown: Mixed-axis inputs, interpolation direction, editor formatting and other builds remain outside the single-axis result.
records.next_evidence: For a transform or direction failure, capture exact input, readback operation and component/basis differences before changing constructors.
records.recheck: Recheck when Studio build, Creator Docs, API dump, rotation order, readback method or relevant project transform path changes.

tested_behavior.context: Ordinary server, independent single-axis half-turns; Angles, fromOrientation, exact matrices and full-component copies.

Preserve the transform without Euler reconstruction, and retain signed rotation or accumulated turns separately.
